Mod.Name: 【修复】掌柜帮手·柜台不丢货 | [Fix] Shopkeeper's Kit: Counter Overflow
Mod.Author: chaos5090
Mod.Description:
【修复型：修游戏 bug，会稍微影响平衡】原版里卖家（小偷、卖水的、杰克逊博士推销设备等）往柜台摆货时，柜台放不下的货会被直接销毁、没有任何提示，一次可能丢掉二十多件。本 mod 把放不下的货分到后面的“页”里：顾客头上的提示框下方出现翻页条“第 1/3 页”，点“上一页/下一页”或按 , 和 .（键帽上的 < >）翻页，按键可在游戏“选项”里改。每一页记住每件货的位置，翻走再翻回来原样摆回；你拿下来的货留下的空位不会被别的货占掉，随时能放回去。顾客离开时，没摆出来的页按原版方式处理。修好后你能看到原本会被销毁的货（例如黑市声望高时小偷的战利品箱），进货机会比原版多。界面仅中文。 掌柜帮手系列 · 作者 chaos5090 · 由 Claude Code（Anthropic 的 AI 编程助手）协助开发。
[Fix - fixes a game bug, small balance impact] When a seller (thieves, water sellers, Dr. Jackson's equipment offers...) lays goods on the counter, anything that doesn't fit is silently destroyed - sometimes twenty or more items at once. With this mod those items go onto extra "pages" instead: a page bar ("第 1/3 页") appears below the notification above the customer's head; click its previous/next buttons or press , and . (the < > keys) to flip. Keys can be rebound in the game's Options. Each page remembers where every item sat and restores it exactly; a gap left by an item you took off stays free, so you can always put it back. When the customer leaves, pages not on display are handled like leftover counter items in the base game. You will see goods the base game would have destroyed (e.g. thieves' loot crates at high Black Market reputation), so you get more buying opportunities. Chinese UI only. Part of Shopkeeper's Kit by chaos5090. Developed with assistance from Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant).
